name: Agenda, with travel time
description: The next days as a list: each day on a row, events with their time, location and the drive from home with the time to leave (Waze, through Home Assistant). Events come from Widgets → Calendar Feeds; waste collections can be added from Mijn Afvalwijzer. Requires the Calendar Core plugin. The drive comes from Waze through Home Assistant (Waze Travel Time integration) or, without it, from the free OSRM service.

cell_options.name: feeds_filter
cell_options.label: Calendars
cell_options.help: Feed IDs, separated by commas. Blank shows every enabled calendar.

cell_options.name: show_symbol
cell_options.label: Feed symbol before titles
cell_options.help: The symbol set for a feed in Calendar Feeds. Off by default: it takes width on every title.

cell_options.name: show_waste
cell_options.label: Waste collection
cell_options.help: Shows the waste collections (from Mijn Afvalwijzer) on their days, with an icon. Needs your postcode and house number under Settings › Widgets › Mijn Afvalwijzer.

cell_options.name: waste_types
cell_options.label: Waste: only these types
cell_options.help: Types separated by commas, for instance gft,restafval. Blank shows every type.

cell_options.name: show_travel
cell_options.label: Drive time and time to leave
cell_options.help: For events with a location that have not started yet: the minutes by car from home, and when to leave.

cell_options.name: travel_source
cell_options.label: Drive time from

choices.label: Waze, and OSRM when Waze does not answer

cell_options.help: Waze needs the Waze Travel Time integration in Home Assistant and has live traffic. OSRM is a free routing service with no traffic: the drive is then an estimate (≈). It sends your home position and the event locations to OSRM and OpenStreetMap.

cell_options.name: origin
cell_options.label: Home (start of the drive)
cell_options.help: A Home Assistant zone or device (zone.home), an address, or latitude,longitude. Kept with the page, never in an exported template.

cell_options.name: osrm_extra_pct
cell_options.label: Surcharge without traffic
cell_options.help: Added to an OSRM drive, which knows no traffic. 15% suits most days; raise it for busy roads.

cell_options.name: margin_min
cell_options.label: Margin
cell_options.help: Extra minutes before the time to leave, for parking and getting out of the door.

cell_options.name: travel_days
cell_options.label: Work out the drive for
cell_options.help: Only events in the first days are sent to Waze.

cell_options.name: language
cell_options.label: Language
cell_options.help: The widget's words in this language, whatever the dashboard's.
